name: Silver Bullet Content Agent
description: A bilingual (English/Chinese) blog covering technology, finance, and lifestyle. Provides content discovery via RSS, sitemap, and markdown content negotiation for AI agents.

skills.name: Content Discovery
skills.description: Discover blog posts and articles via RSS feed, sitemap, or llms.txt index. Supports full-text search through structured metadata.
examples: Fetch the latest blog posts from the RSS feed
List all articles tagged with 'linux' or 'kernel'
Get the full article list from llms.txt

skills.name: Markdown Content Negotiation
skills.description: Retrieve article content in markdown format by sending Accept: text/markdown header. Returns clean, formatting-stripped text optimized for AI consumption.
examples: Retrieve any article as plain markdown for processing

skills.name: Bilingual Content Access
skills.description: Access articles in both English and Chinese. Each post is available in two language versions at the same path with .zh.md suffix for markdown.
examples: Get English version: /posts/<slug>/ with Accept: text/markdown
